Title: Event Grid on IoT Edge is now available in preview

Body.Content:
Event Grid on IoT Edge enables the adoption of event-driven architectures on solutions created for disconnected environments or hybrid setups, bringing a powerful cloud application pattern to a non-cloud environment. 

Now available in public preview, this IoT Edge module enables the pub-sub semantics available in Azure Event Grid to work between modules within the same edge device and also between edge devices for disconnected environments, as well as send events from the edge to the cloud for hybrid solutions.  

Learn more
